column7: ADR-112 Amendment 5: the require_mfa upgrade grace period ends at the first global admin-tier holder with a second factor (a non-admin enrolling does not end it), latches, writes adr112.require_mfa.enforced and never reopens (the admin dropping the factor again does not restore it). The 30-day hard stop is TestMFAUpgradeGrace_EndsAtTheDeadline; the clock rules TestMFAUpgradeGrace_BackwardClockStepDoesNotExtend / _FloorBoundsTheClock / _ForwardClockStepEndsSooner; fail closed TestMFAUpgradeGrace_UnreadableFactsFailClosed. Each runs on SQLite and, with KEYORIX_TEST_PG_DSN, PostgreSQL.
